title: The Red Sea
paragraphs: The area around the Red Sea is one of the hottest places in the world. Because of this, the water in the sea evaporates fast. Usually, the sea does not dry up because other water comes in from the Gulf of Aden at the southern end. However, the sea is very narrow there, and in the past the channel has closed. When that happened, the sea dried up. The salt was left behind and, today, there are some places where the salt is almost 4 km (2.5 miles) thick. Most of this salt is now covered with rock.

Today some companies are mining the bottom of the Red Sea. There are cracks in the sea bottom and warm sea water enters them. The water carries different salts and minerals out of the cracks back to the sea floor. There, the hot sea water, which is heavier than ordinary sea water, forms pools. These pools cool and the salts and minerals become solid again. Because of this process, there are large quantities of copper (Cu), nickel (Ni) and other metals on the seafloor. These metals are very useful, but we must make sure that we don't damage the animal and plant life of the Red Sea.
